Money.description: Local, user-entered benefit comparison. See docs/open-enrollment.md for boundaries.

retirementSpendingSource.description: Migration never silently mixes category detail with an old aggregate.

allocations.description: Optional explanation of the envelope; never additional spending rows.

nextDueDate.description: ISO date anchors actual cash dates. Without one, only averages are known.

payroll.description: All values are per paycheck; withholding is income tax only.

throughMonth.description: Expense repeats monthly through this month; absent means one-time.

baseline.description: Immutable local snapshot; never sent to a server.

source.const: Bureau of Labor Statistics, CPI-U, U.S. City Average, All Items

method.const: (313.689 / 188.9)^(1 / 20) - 1; compound annual change, not the average of yearly percentage changes

limitation.const: Historical reference, not a forecast. This window ends in 2024; October 2025 CPI is unavailable, so this is not labeled the latest rolling 20-year annual-average window.

withholdingPercent.description: Entered income-tax withholding only; blank preserves unknown deposit timing.
